mathematical_cautions_recorded: Do not promote textbook asymptotic assertions lacking stated hypotheses or proofs (notably sample-ACF and raw-periodogram limit claims) to theorem dependencies.
Correct the South Carolina invertibility root-condition wording from its theorem erratum; do not copy source typos in limiting statements or complex covariance formulas.

For simple/ordinary/universal kriging, state finite-second-moment, unbiasedness, covariance invertibility or augmented-system rank assumptions explicitly; distinguish Gaussian conditional-mean claims from general best-linear prediction.
For state-space models, include state/observation/noise assumptions as definition data; leave Kalman and other computational filtering algorithms in category 3.

Last-Penrose Theorem 13.7 uses Laplace-transform uniqueness Proposition B.5; the proposition is stated in read Appendix B.1 but its proof cites an external source not read, so directing-measure identifiability is not a proved scaffold dependency.
Last-Penrose Chapter 9 Theorem 9.1 uses Proposition 6.3; its proof is now read in Section 6.1, PDF pp. 57-60. Chapter 13 Theorem 13.11 still invokes unread Chapter 6 results and is not used.
